ai_rules: All command logic must be strictly decoupled from business/core logic; commands may only invoke core services via dependency injection, with zero direct implementation dependencies.
All user-facing output must be routed through a centralized UI service using chalk and ora, ensuring consistent styling, loading states, and error formatting across all CLI interactions.
Core domain modules must be strictly testable in isolation using @oclif/test and @types/chai, with 100% unit test coverage for all non-utility core modules and 85%+ for command handlers.
Third-party dependencies (e.g., fs, child_process via shx) must be abstracted behind interface adapters in /src/core, enabling mockability and runtime substitution in testing environments.
All runtime configuration and environment variables must be validated at process entry using dotenv and a strict schema checker, with automatic failure on missing/invalid critical values.
